description:
Search LinkedIn job postings by keyword and location. Returns title, company, location, posting date, salary hint and the job id you pass to linkedin-jobs-detail. Reads LinkedIn's public guest surface — no LinkedIn account or cookie is required.

upAPI operation `linkedin-jobs-search.get` (Social Media). Costs 6 units of monthly quota per call.

keywords.description: Job title, skill or company to search for (e.g. "python developer")
keywords.title: Keywords

location.description: City, region or country to search in (e.g. "United States")
location.title: Location

page.description: 1-based results page. LinkedIn's guest surface returns 10 postings per page.
page.title: Page

proxyUrl.description: User-provided proxy URL. Omit to use the operation's own datacenter pool.
proxyUrl.title: Proxyurl

timePosted.description: Recency filter: any, past-month, past-week or past-24h
timePosted.title: Timeposted

workplaceType.description: Workplace filter: any, on-site, remote or hybrid
workplaceType.title: Workplacetype

name: linkedin_jobs_search_get
title: Search LinkedIn Jobs
